Prepare step by step

  1. Stop driving and use emergency or towing help if the vehicle is unsafe.
  2. Keep the VIN, title, odometer disclosure, advertisement, Buyers Guide, inspection, warranty and communications under your control.
  3. Use official recall and title-history routes; do not treat a single database as a complete guarantee.
  4. Separate safety, repair, title, warranty, financing and legal questions.
